data.narrative:
Gecko Robotics is a Series D robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $125M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 companies: 1 public (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Exotec, Hadrian, Divergent, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI, all operating in the same sector and stage band.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $125M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $188M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Divergent ($2.3B Series E), Exotec ($2.0B Series D), Hadrian ($1.6B Series D), Agile Robots ($1.0B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.3B.

Triangulation across both methods implies a valuation range of $159M (floor) to $1.8B (ceiling), with a median of $894M. The wide dispersion reflects material differences in growth trajectory and revenue scale across the peer set. The stage-progression method is constrained by reliance on raised capital as a proxy, while peer comparables are anchored to late-stage private and pre-IPO valuations. Key uncertainties include relative product differentiation, customer concentration, and path to profitability versus comparable firms.
